nodes.name: AgentOrgCliMemberParity.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of the Agent Org CLI member capability boundary, documenting fixes that hide unsupported CLI agents from the Session Creator member picker, Agent Org wizard, and org detail view while leaving the general CLI picker unaffected.

nodes.name: AppMark.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of the AppMark brand icon component, covering design-token usage, hardcoded sizing constants, and an accessibility fix adding an optional title/aria-label for non-decorative use.

nodes.name: GitProfileSidebar.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of the reusable settings sidebar/detail shell introduced for Git Profiles, recommending abstraction of the sidebar-split layout and fixing Git-specific selected-row and action-button styling to use neutral shared tokens.

nodes.name: GitProfiles.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of the Git Profiles table and profile-editing tab, confirming consistent reuse of shared tabs, section containers, form controls, and a responsive master-detail layout with no outstanding design-system violations.

nodes.name: KanbanNamingCleanup.md
nodes.summary: UI audit tracking a naming-consistency sweep that makes Kanban and Work Items the only product-facing names across the sidebar, ChatPanel, Start Page, Spotlight, and localization files, removing retired route and icon references.

nodes.name: LaunchpadSessionLauncher.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of the consolidated Launchpad Work/Manage/Trends tab selector, its centered session launcher, tone-colored actions, and the lazily-mounted Manage surface, finding all elements kept with documented reasoning.

nodes.name: SettingsSurfaces.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of shared settings-page primitives (SectionContainer, SectionRow, SettingsTable) that fixes inconsistent container radius, missing borders on direct token consumers, and cramped row spacing to standardize a canonical 12px radius.

nodes.name: SharedAccountDetails.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of the shared Key Vault account-detail surface reused between Settings and the Chat launchpad, recommending abstraction of several layout primitives and fixing missing interactive/test-hook semantics on the key tile and inline info card.

nodes.name: WorkManagementChatTabs.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of the ChatPanel tab strip, default-fullscreen Kanban management host, and retained Kanban sidebar navigation, confirming consistent tab chrome, sidebar selection, and accessibility semantics with no fixes required.

nodes.name: WorkManagementGitHub.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of the new Kanban GitHub Issues and PRs destinations, covering their filter/list layout, repository selector, and in-place detail views, finding consistent reuse of existing design-system primitives.

nodes.name: WorkManagementGitHubLazyClosedPrs.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of the Kanban GitHub PR Open/Closed controls, adding the missing Closed destination with lazy fetch-on-select behavior, deferred count pills, and page-restoration handling.

nodes.name: WorkManagementGitHubLists.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of shared GitHub-style issue/PR row, summary-header, pagination, and sidebar view-preset primitives in Kanban, recommending abstraction of the toolbar, list frame, and pagination footer while keeping domain-specific content in slots.

nodes.name: WorkManagementGitHubSidebarConsolidation.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of removing the GitHub-only secondary sidebar rail and consolidating repository, filter, and action controls into the existing primary Kanban sidebar via a portal, restoring full-width list/detail content.

nodes.name: WorkManagementNavigationHierarchy.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of the Kanban navigation hierarchy that exposes Kanban as a top-level sidebar destination, groups Projects/GitHub Issues/PRs under an expandable Work Items row, removes the duplicate in-page sidebar, and moves the view-mode switch into the shared header.
